uutiset.t: England's Hull one stroke off lead at lucrative LPGA finale
uutiset.s: England's Charley Hull cards a six-under 66 to sit one shot off the first-round lead at the LPGA's lucrative season-ending CME Group Tour Championship.

uutiset.t: 'Clearer' approach has lifted England mood - Itoje
uutiset.s: Captain Maro Itoje says a clearer sense of purpose and unity has coincided with improved performances from England this autumn.

uutiset.t: Unbeaten Zverev hopes to be 'pain-free' after overcoming Fils at ATP Finals
uutiset.s: World number one Alexander Zverev says he will do "everything I can to be pain-free" after hurting his ankle during his ATP Finals victory over Arthur Fils.

uutiset.t: Barcelona target Man Utd's Martinez - Friday's gossip
uutiset.s: Barcelona interested in Lisandro Martinez, while Manchester United target Fulham defensive pair and Liverpool scout Serie A top scorer, plus more.

uutiset.t: F1 to introduce full-time race stewards from 2027
uutiset.s: Formula 1's governing body the FIA is to introduce permanent race stewards from the 2027 season.

uutiset.t: Armagh to begin Ulster defence against Derry
uutiset.s: Armagh will begin the defence of their Ulster Senior Football Championship title in 2027 with a home quarter-final against Derry.

uutiset.t: Shevchenko accuses Mudryk camp of 'baseless slander'
uutiset.s: Ukraine great Andriy Shevchenko accuses Mykhailo Mudryk of a "baseless slander" after the on-loan Tottenham winger blamed his failed drugs test on the nation's football association.

uutiset.t: Frank happy to be 'back in the circus' at Palace
uutiset.s: Thomas Frank is happy to be "back in the circus" after speaking at his first news conference as Crystal Palace manager.

uutiset.t: Swansea 'acknowledge' Matos move - 23 hours after Strasbourg
uutiset.s: Swansea City belatedly confirm that boss Vitor Matos has left the Championship club by saying only that they "acknowledge" Strasbourg's statement over his move to the French club.

uutiset.t: New manager Frick to take Aberdeen back to basics
uutiset.s: Head coach Mario Frick says his track record proves he can produce exciting football - but a back-to-basics approach is needed at Aberdeen.

uutiset.t: England fined for fans' anti-Catholic chants in Spain
uutiset.s: England are punished by Uefa following anti-Catholic chanting from the away fans during their Nations League victory in Spain.

uutiset.t: Gloucester-Hartpury boss Murphy exits on season eve
uutiset.s: Gloucester-Hartpury head of rugby Dan Murphy leaves the club on the eve of the new Premiership Women's Rugby season.

uutiset.t: Pochettino's first Man Utd training session filmed by drone operator
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino's first Manchester United training session has been filmed by fan with a drone from outside the club's Carrington training ground.

uutiset.t: We'll only sell if offer makes club blink - McInnes
uutiset.s: Manager Derek McInnes says Rangers will only sell players in January if they receive offers that "makes the club blink".

uutiset.t: Struggling Blackpool sack Evatt on his birthday
uutiset.s: Blackpool sack head coach Ian Evatt after a year in charge following a run of one win and six defeats in their past 10 league games.
